name: Elec-Tron
description: Elec-Tron of Wichita, Kansas has been proudly manufacturing power termination and electrical connectors in the USA since 1946.  Founded as Zimco Metal Products in April 1946, the company operated primarily as a contract manufacturer, producing miscellaneous metal stampings and assemblies. In 1954, the company changed its focus to producing primarily electrical switches, terminal blocks, and terminal boards. As Elec-Tron’s reputation for quality and timely delivery grew, the company began serving most major appliance manufacturers in the U.S. and abroad.
